What we keep running

Eight services tied to the season, not a generic list.

  • Aerobic maintenance plans

    Three visits a year: air pump, spray heads, chlorinator and sludge level checked and logged.

    Price it

  • Aerobic air pump repair

    A quiet plant means a dead air pump; we test it, rebuild it or swap it.

    Price it

  • Septic tank pumping

    Conventional tanks and aerobic plants pumped, with the trash tank and clarifier both checked.

    Price it

  • Alarm and control panel repair

    Red lights and beeping panels traced to the timer, float or breaker, then fixed.

    Price it

  • Chlorinator and spray head service

    Tablet feeders cleaned and refilled, clogged spray heads cleared and aimed off the patio.

    Price it

  • After-storm restarts

    Flooded plants pumped down, dried out and restarted once the water drops after a storm.

    Price it

  • Real estate inspections

    Plant and tank inspected for buyers and sellers, with a written report before closing.

    Price it

  • New aerobic systems

    Aerobic plants sized and set for heavy clay and a high water table.

    Price it

What a visit looks like

Four checks, one visit, no guesswork.

01

Air pump test

We listen for the hum, check amperage and rebuild or swap if it is tired.

02

Chlorinator refill

Tablets topped up, feeder cleaned, spray heads aimed off the patio.

03

Sludge level

Tank probed to measure what is in it; pumped only when it needs it.

04

Alarm panel

Lights and timer checked so the next red blink is not a surprise.

Wet backyard after an Acadiana downpour.

  • Septic or aerobic pumping $325 – $600 all chambers, depending on size
  • Alarm and panel repair $150 – $450 timer, float or breaker
